infracraft.book.subway.1:
━ Subway Handbook ━

Go underground!
This kit builds tunnels
and stations; trains
come from Create
(Create Fly) and its
addons.

Follow the next pages.
infracraft.book.subway.2:
1. Supplies

· Subway shield machine
· Tunnel lining 64+
  (8 stone + clay → 16)
· Create track
  (or vanilla rails)
· Tunnel lights
· Station blueprint
infracraft.book.subway.3:
2. Planning

Click both station sites
with the surveyor to get
distance and height.
Create track likes gentle
curves, so plan long
straight runs.
infracraft.book.subway.4:
3. Boring

Stand between the two
tracks and use the
shield: an 11×5 double-
track tunnel with two
lines (one per way),
lining and lights.
Look down/up for a ramp.
infracraft.book.subway.5:
4. Water & lava

Lining is placed before
the slice is cleared, so
aquifers and lava stay
out. Bedrock and block
entities are left alone.
infracraft.book.subway.6:
5. Stations

Stand between the tracks
facing along the line
and use the blueprint:
two side platforms (level
with car floors), screen
doors, lights and an
elevator on each side.
Platform 1 is the right.
infracraft.book.subway.7:
6. Cars

Use a metro car plan on
Create track: it builds a
5×9 body from Create
blocks and glues it. Put
bogeys on the two marked
blocks with train casing
and assemble at the
station.
infracraft.book.subway.8:
7. Safe running

Double track by default,
so opposite directions
never meet. Create
trains derail on impact:
put signals around
stations. Minecarts stop
for the cart ahead (ATS).

infracraft.book.subway.9:
8. Stations & signs

· Click a signpost: nearby
  stations
· Sneak-click: network
· Ticket on a station:
  route to destination
· Ticket on a switch:
  route that destination

No teleports here.
Enjoy the view!
